notes:
Your console can no longer lose the setting it needs to boot. On V2 and OLED a missing
DVFS value could leave you at a frozen splash with no error, and nothing in the launcher
ever wrote that setting, so a reset or a recovery entry could drop it. The boot script
now sets it itself. Safe Mode had the same hole and is fixed too. V1 was never affected.

The official Wii U GameCube adapter now works, with all four ports appearing as normal
controllers everywhere. Nobody has physically pressed a button on one yet, so reports
are welcome.

PS2 memory cards no longer run out of space. Every PS2 game shared one 8 MB card, so a
few big saves filled it. Slot 1 becomes a folder card with no practical limit and your
saves move across on the first PS2 launch, with the old card file kept as a backup.

Also: your CPU max clock stays where you put it, there is a Reset to stock button in the
Overclocking menu, RAM voltage finally shows on V1, Cemu lists games from both storage
areas with its face buttons the right way round, the Wii pointer can be mapped to a
stick, and a game left untouched can now sleep itself and wake on the same frame.

Fixed: the RAM tuner refusing to start while your library was full, Wii U updates making
a second icon, and system updates showing a silent black screen mid install.
